help.title: About Stories
help.overview: A Story is a marketing journal article for a project (optionally an edifice or unit). It is public-site content when published. It is not a construction update (site progress) and not a snag (defect).

sections.title: What a story holds
items: Story type (required) — from Configurations → Story types.
Title, full content, optional excerpt for cards.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create a story, attach media, set story type, then publish when copy is ready.
Unpublished stories stay in the panel only.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Publishing does not change unit status or construction dates.
Construction updates are the operational progress posts; keep marketing narrative here.

sections.title: Related records
items: Project, optional edifice/unit, story type. Public site journal. Complementary: Construction updates.
